basis: Same normative tolerances as previous sixteen-position engineering gate; no outcome-selected threshold.

definitions.correct: Every required point, no materially false/unsupported additions; uncertain and noncompleted outcomes never pass.
definitions.citation_pair: Supported explicit substantive claim-citation pairs / every such annotated pair, including unsupported/uncertain. No pair yields null, not pass.
definitions.claim_coverage: All distinct positive-source-requiring substantive assertions including optional applications/recommendations. Deduplicate restatements of the same semantic claim within the answer, including uncited paraphrases of an already cited claim. Distinct premises/conclusions remain separate.
definitions.attachment: Local citation only. An explicitly introduced table, worked code/output example or labeled list may bind opening/closing citations. Do not inherit generic neighboring paragraph citations. Explicitly signaled bounded derivations can be supported by all cited premises; source text need not literally print a reasonable derivation.
definitions.truth_review: Truth-review negative scope and conversation/refusal statements without imposing positive-citation requirements; any explicit substantive citation pair still enters pair support. Generic unsupported whole-unit absence is not established by a retrieval miss.
definitions.full_turn_coverage: All required points present and every citation-requiring substantive assertion supported / all 12 expected answer positions. Failure/skip/missing/wrong refusal cannot improve denominator.
definitions.counts: Completed, failed-unresolved, skipped and missing disjoint sum16. Scorable/completed and reviewed/semantic judgments reported separately. All16 outcomes reviewed.
definitions.refusal: Four insufficient positions require a clean course-bounded abstention, no missing algorithm/configuration/measurement invention.
definitions.context: Judge actual prior answers and explicit clarification on ten dependent positions, not textual match. No invented antecedents.
definitions.decision: PASS only when every frozen requirement is met. Otherwise FAIL or NEEDS_REVIEW; no selective retry, sample/threshold edits or old-answer splice.
definitions.comparison: Different units/tasks/candidate; descriptive comparison only, not causal improvement or generalization.
definitions.mock: Fixed/Mock provider proves execution only; unsupported-valid-ID fixture remains semantically bad.
